notes: Read all 323 source lines (numbered) before editing. The web component is a category-grouped widget catalogue dialog: it lists the registry grouped by category, badges already-added widgets as 'Added' (and disables their Add button), supports a name/description/category search with a live result count + empty state, and on pick calls onAdd(widgetId) then onClose(). All of that behaviour, every state name, the i18n keys + English defaults, and the testIDs are preserved 1:1 in the native port.

L1 `import { useMemo, useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react'` -> `import React, {useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState}`: React added for the RN JSX runtime + the `React.ReactElement` return types; useCallback added to back the native useTranslation shim.

L2 `import { useTranslation } from 'react-i18next'` -> a self-contained native-safe useTranslation() hook returning {t}; react-i18next is web wiring. The t(key, fallback, options?) shim preserves every key, English default and {{var}} interpolation (subtitle/resultCount/emptyBody/addLabel) — the LayoutSwitcher/AcknowledgeAlertDialog precedent.

L3 `import { Search } from 'lucide-react'` -> dropped; lucide is browser-only. The Input's left search affordance becomes a small decorative magnifier glyph (🔍, importantForAccessibility='no') inside the native searchRow (the DashboardGrid/LayoutSwitcher lucide-glyph precedent).

L4 `import { Modal, Button, Badge, Input } from '@/components/ui'` -> react-native <Modal transparent visible onRequestClose> (overlay + backdrop Pressable honoring the web onClose), <TextInput> (Input), a module-scope CatalogueButton Pressable (Button, size='sm') and an inline pill View (Badge variant='neutral'). Those UI barrels are not native parity manifest entries (the AcknowledgeAlertDialog dialog precedent). AppText + theme tokens (colors/shadows/spacing/typography) added.

L5 `import { WIDGET_REGISTRY } from '../widgets/registry'` -> the web registry maps each id to a browser-only LucideIcon + a React.lazy widget bundle and is NOT in the native parity manifest. Per conversion-contract rule 7 the native catalogue is sourced from the EXISTING native registry NATIVE_WIDGET_REGISTRY (imported from src/widgets via ../../../../widgets — the same module DashboardWidgets.test.tsx exercises) and adapted into WidgetDef via .map (title -> name; id/description/category/icon passed through). This yields a REAL grouped catalogue of native widgets rather than an empty stub.

L6 `import type { WidgetCategory, WidgetDef } from '../widgets/types'` -> inlined: `WidgetCategory` is derived as `NativeWidgetDefinition['category']` (so the source's CATEGORY_ORDER/labels/emoji apply to real native categories) and `WidgetDef` is reduced to the fields the catalogue reads (id, name, description, icon, category) with the web `icon: LucideIcon` -> native `icon: SemanticIconName`.
